This module sets up the logging configuration for the CI/CD server application. It configures the logger with appropriate formatting and output destinations.

CI_CD_server.src.config.test_logger_config module¶

This module sets up the logging configuration specifically for test runs in the CI/CD pipeline. It configures a dedicated logger with appropriate formatting for tracking test execution results.
